scene clearnightsky
Everything has been removed from the school.
lines.zh: 学校里的一切都被搬空了。

lines.en: It’s an empty box — one that’s quite unsettling given how different it is from what I’m used to. And that makes me think about girls.
lines.zh: 那是个空盒子——和我熟悉的样子差得太远，让人相当不安。而这让我想起女孩子。

lines.en: A specific girl, of course. One who’s also had everything removed from her. But that’s vacated enough space inside that body of hers to welcome my cock no matter the time or place or mood.
lines.zh: 当然是某个特定的女孩。一个同样被掏空了一切的女孩。但那在她身体里腾出了足够的空间，无论何时何地、何种心情，都欢迎我的鸡巴。

lines.en: I enjoy having sex with her. The kind that makes her cry, just in the good way.
lines.zh: 我喜欢和她做爱。是那种会让她哭出来的——只不过是好的那种哭。

lines.en: But I think that, even more than that, I enjoy the thrill of not knowing what comes next or whether or not my next cumshot will kill her.
lines.zh: 但我想，比这更甚的是，我喜欢那种不知道接下来会发生什么的刺激——不知道我下一发会不会把她操死。

lines.en: I think that, to a certain extent, I am able to pull out the insides of everyone. But I mean this not in a manner involving violent prolapse, I mean it in the fact that I have become a shepherd.
lines.zh: 我觉得，在某种程度上，我能把每个人的内脏都掏出来。我不是说那种暴力的脱垂，我是说——我已经成了一个牧羊人。

lines.en: Neither sheep nor lambs know where they are being led. They just know to follow. So if I were to take someone up here with the intent of slaughtering them, I’d surely accomplish it without issue.
lines.zh: 绵羊和羊羔都不知道自己被牵去哪儿。它们只知道跟着走。所以如果我带谁上这儿来、打算宰了他，我一定能毫无阻碍地办到。

lines.en: If I understood the way this worked///If I understood how to turn back the clock///If I understood the sky above me, I would not hesitate to lasso the moon.
lines.zh: 如果我明白这一切的运作方式／／／如果我明白怎么把时钟拨回去／／／如果我明白头顶的这片天空，我会毫不犹豫地用套索套住月亮。

lines.en: I’m just not sure which would be the correct one to drag down. But neither do I know which falling star to make a wish on as they {i}all{/i} come spiraling down near the end of the world.
lines.zh: 我只是不确定该把哪一个拽下来。也不知道该对哪颗流星许愿——在世界末日临近时，它们{i}全都{/i}盘旋着坠落。

lines.en: Instead, I’ll make a million wishes — and with each of them wish for a million more. For I care not if the monkey’s paw claws at and infects me when I’ve always loved the look of scars.
lines.zh: 于是，我会许下一百万个愿望——每一个愿望里再许下一百万个。因为我一向喜欢伤疤的样子，又怎会在意猴爪来抓挠我、感染我。

lines.en: I just want to be somewhere else with someone I love.
lines.zh: 我只想和我爱的人待在别的某个地方。

lines.en: Sometimes, I can trick myself into believing it’s possible.
lines.zh: 有时候，我能骗自己相信这是可能的。

lines.en: But other times-
lines.zh: 但另一些时候——

lines.en: Other times, I’m forced to confront the crippling notion that I can’t do {i}anything{/i} without first asking permission.
lines.zh: 另一些时候，我被迫面对那个令人崩溃的念头：不先请求许可，我就{i}什么都做不了{/i}。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof1
When my eyes meet a familiar body dressed in a familiar color, I think about God. I think about being younger.
lines.zh: 当我的目光落在一具穿着熟悉颜色的熟悉身体上时，我想到了神。我想到了更年轻的自己。

lines.en: I think of why I began to resent faith and how my relationship with what may or may not be real is just as real as my relationship with what most assuredly is. Or was. Or is going to be. And that scares me.
lines.zh: 我想起自己为什么开始憎恨信仰；想起我与那些可能存在、也可能不存在的东西之间的关系，和我对那些确凿存在过、存在着、将要存在的事物的关系一样真实。而这让我害怕。

lines.en: There’s a pit in my stomach that’s meant to grow into a tree. Something or someone planted it there in some earlier event or something. But now, it’s growing in the wrong direction.
lines.zh: 我的胃里有一个坑，本该长出一棵树。不知是什么东西、什么人在更早的某个事件里把它种在了那儿。可现在，它在朝错误的方向生长。

lines.en: And each step I take closer to what or who should be familiar just makes me feel lost.
lines.zh: 而我每向那个本该熟悉的东西、本该熟悉的人走近一步，就只觉得更迷失。

lines.en: My sanity slips away as if I’m wearing her dress again, touching myself in the mirror to try and deceive myself into believing it’s her.
lines.zh: 我的理智在流失，仿佛我又穿上了她的裙子，在镜子里抚摸自己，骗自己相信那就是她。

lines.en: But it never worked then and it won’t work now because mannequins, no matter how real they may look, lack the defining trait that makes humans {i}human.{/i}
lines.zh: 可那招以前不管用，现在也不会管用——因为人体模型不管看起来多逼真，都缺少那个使人成为{i}人{/i}的决定性特征。

lines.en: Malice.
lines.zh: 恶意。

lines.en: I look at her, but she doesn’t look at me.
lines.zh: 我看着她，她却不看我。

lines.en: And something feels right, but everything else feels wrong.
lines.zh: 有某样东西感觉是对的，可其他一切都感觉是错的。

lines.en: I feel as if I’m about to make a grave mistake.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己马上就要犯下一个严重的错误。

lines.en: But I also feel like I {i}have{/i} to.
lines.zh: 但我也觉得我{i}非犯不可{/i}。

lines.en: One final thought — a present for you before I empty out another box of puzzle pieces in search of a suitable replacement. It doesn’t have to be perfect, it just has to fit.
lines.zh: 最后一个念头——在我又把一盒拼图倒空、去找合适的替代品之前，先送你一份礼物。它不必完美，只要合得上就行。

lines.en: That thought is this.
lines.zh: 这个念头就是。

lines.en: I would make a terrible father.
lines.zh: 我会是个糟糕透顶的父亲。

lines.en: : Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof2
: Nyaa?
: You’re hiding something from me, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在瞒着我什么，对吧？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof3
: I’m glad you have arrived, Friend! You can use your strong human arms to protect me from the falling space rocks, nyaa!
lines.zh: : 你来得正好，朋友！你可以用你强壮的人类手臂保护我，别让天上掉下来的太空石头砸到我，喵！

lines.en: : What are the problems? Your sight spheres have expanded and your mouth arches down instead of up, nyaa!
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗？你的眼球都瞪大了，嘴巴也朝下弯、不朝上弯了，喵！

lines.en: : You’re the one who sent Nao to come and get me, aren’t you? Which obviously means you know something about the resets. Which obviously means you’ve been hiding something that-
lines.zh: : 是你让 Nao 去找我的，对吧？那显然意味着你知道时间重置的事。那显然意味着你一直在隐瞒什么——

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof4
: You think too much, Friend! Your words hurt the meat inside of my head-bone. I just wanted to see the colors.
lines.zh: : 你想太多了，朋友！你的话弄疼了我头骨里面的肉。我只是想看看那些颜色。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof5
: Do you not believe my tonguewords? Your face bears the look of doubt, nyaa!
lines.zh: : 你不相信我的舌头话吗？你脸上写满了怀疑，喵！

lines.en: : If I had known the sadness would overtake you, I’d have made the hot meat come today too!
lines.zh: : 我要是知道悲伤会压垮你，我今天就让那块热肉也来了！

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof6
: Have you forgotten how to move your lips?
lines.zh: : 你忘了怎么动嘴唇了吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m just impatiently waiting for the “you inside of you” to come back so I can speak to her instead since {i}she’s{/i} the one who understands what’s going on and you’re just a tool.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是在不耐烦地等着「你体内的那个你」回来，好让我跟她说话——因为{i}她{/i}才懂发生了什么，而你只是个工具。

lines.en: : A tool, nyaa?
lines.zh: : 工具，喵？

lines.en: : That’s right. Because apparently, it’s not enough for my life to be riddled with timeloops. I have to deal with {i}ghosts{/i} too. And you, for some reason, have been possessed by the one that haunts me.
lines.zh: : 没错。因为显然，我的人生被时间循环塞满还不够，我还得应付{i}鬼魂{/i}。而你，不知为什么，被那个缠着我的鬼附了身。

lines.en: : Is that why we did the kiss move? Because of your ghost?
lines.zh: : 所以我们才做了亲亲那个动作吗？因为你的鬼？

lines.en: : Either that or my {i}daughter{/i} has figured out a way to telepathically insert herself into your body. Which, you know, wouldn’t be all that surprising either.
lines.zh: : 要么就是我{i}女儿{/i}想出了某种办法，能心灵感应地把自己塞进你的身体里。话说回来，那也不算多让人意外。

lines.en: : But only {i}two{/i} people have those eyes, and you’re not one of them.
lines.zh: : 但只有{i}两{/i}个人有那双眼睛，而你不是其中之一。

lines.en: : That’s not true, Friend. Nao-chan has one of them, doesn’t she? One for your tiny human and one for a thing that doesn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 不对哦，朋友。Nao 酱有一只，不是吗？一只是给你这个小小人类的，一只是给一个不存在的东西的。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “a thing that doesn’t exist?”
lines.zh: : 「一个不存在的东西」是什么意思？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof7
: Exactly as I said, nyaa!
lines.zh: : 就是我说的那个意思，喵！

lines.en: : The source of her second eye is a mystery, nyaa! An impossible color, nyaa! One that you stole and ruined, n-
lines.zh: : 她第二只眼睛的来源是个谜，喵！一种不可能存在的颜色，喵！一种你偷走又毁掉的——

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof8
: -yaaaaa?!??!

: I’m not here to play games, Kaori. Nor do I have the time to humor that nonsensical, stupid fucking way of speaking. Just tell me why I’m here without any of the bullshit. And if {i}you{/i} don’t know-
lines.zh: : 我不是来玩游戏的，Kaori。我也没时间陪你那套胡说八道、蠢得要命的说话方式。别废话，直接告诉我为什么我在这里。要是{i}你{/i}不知道——

lines.en: : You have all the time in the world, Friend.
lines.zh: : 你有的是时间，朋友。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof9
: You have all the time in the world.
lines.zh: : 你有的是时间。

lines.en: : How do you know that?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道？……

lines.en: : Because I’ve been watching!
lines.zh: : 因为我一直在看着！

lines.en: : I like you very much, Friend! You should see how many pages I have filled out in my friendship journal!
lines.zh: : 我非常喜欢你，朋友！你真该看看我的友情日记写了多少页！

lines.en: : My favorite part of having extra eyes is always seeing double! And you are so fascinating that I can never look away!
lines.zh: : 有额外的眼睛，我最喜欢的部分就是永远都能看成双份！而你实在太迷人了，我根本移不开眼！

lines.en: : Please! Tell me all about that thing you do with your hands, nyaa!
lines.zh: : 求你了！跟我说说你用手做的那件事吧，喵！

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof10
: Or I guess you can just stand there and be a little bitch about it instead, nyaa.
lines.zh: : 或者你也可以就那么站着，当个小婊子，喵。

lines.zh: : 别告诉我——

lines.zh: : 她消失是{i}你的{/i}错。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} did this.
lines.zh: : 是{i}你{/i}干的。

lines.en: : Did what, Friend?
lines.zh: : 我干了什么，朋友？

lines.en: : It’s {i}your{/i} fault she’s gone! You’re the one who made me do that to her!
lines.zh: : 她消失是{i}你的{/i}错！是你让我对她做那种事的！

lines.en: : No way, nyaa! I’ve never even touched a meat stick before! I’m not even sure where they go, nyaa.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢，喵！我连肉棒都没碰过！我甚至不确定它们该插哪儿，喵。

lines.en: : I’m going to fucking kill you.
lines.zh: : 我他妈要杀了你。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof14
: Hey now, Friend! Let’s not get too hasty! I think there’s still a big misunderstanding here.
lines.zh: : 哎哎，朋友！别这么冲动！我觉得这儿还有个大误会。

lines.en: : There’s still some weirdo buried somewhere inside this sack of meat. She’s just left enough room for me to come in and hang out.
lines.zh: : 这袋肉里面还埋着个怪人。她只是给我留了足够的地方，让我进来待着。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you mean “come in and hang out?” How can you be the voice inside of my head {i}and{/i} hers?
lines.zh: : 「进来待着」你他妈的是什么意思？你怎么既是我脑子里的声音，{i}又{/i}是她的？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof15
: Because it’s not {i}just me,{/i} numnuts. It’s {i}all{/i} of us.
lines.zh: : 因为不止{i}我一个{/i}啊，蠢蛋。是我们{i}所有人{/i}。

lines.en: : All of {i}who?{/i} Who the fuck are you? Besides a manipulative sack of shit, that is.
lines.zh: : 所有{i}谁{/i}？你他妈到底是谁？除了一袋子操控人心的狗屎之外。

lines.en: : Hey, {i}I’m{/i} not the one who’s fucking a class of high schoolers. I’m just the one who watches. We’re not the same.
lines.zh: : 嘿，在一整个班的高中生里乱搞的人可不是{i}我{/i}。我只是看着的那个。我们可不一样。

lines.en: : But if you {i}really{/i} don’t get it, let me put it in terms that even someone with soup for brains can understand.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是{i}真{/i}不明白，我就用你那颗进了汤的脑子也能听懂的方式说吧。

lines.en: : This body’s kind of like a sweet, low-cost Airbnb. And every season, different tourists show up and want to rent it out. You have any idea how long this place has been on my wish list? Fucking eons, yo.
lines.zh: : 这具身体有点像一间又甜又便宜的 Airbnb。每年不同季节都有不同的游客来租。你知不知道这地方在我的心愿单上躺了多久？他妈的好几个纪元了，兄弟。

lines.en: : Only downside is that it’s like a guesthouse sort of deal. So sometimes, the others wake up and try to make me take out my trash or whatever, but I just whack ‘em with a frying pan and knock ‘em out ‘til later.
lines.zh: : 唯一的缺点是，它是那种民宿形式的。所以有时候别的房客会醒来，想让我去倒垃圾什么的，我就拿平底锅敲他们，把他们打晕，等以后再说。

lines.en: : So-
lines.zh: : 所以——

lines.en: : So you’re looking at God right now. But not just one god. Two. Three. Four. As many as we can cram inside. And there’s nothing you can do about it since you’ll be the same as her one day.
lines.zh: : 所以你现在看着的是神。而且不是一个神。是两个。三个。四个。能塞多少就塞多少。而你对此无能为力，因为总有一天你也会变得跟她一样。

lines.en: : Why {i}Kaori,{/i} though? She’s just a girl. She’s never done anything wrong, has she?
lines.zh: : 可为什么是 {i}Kaori{/i}？她只是个女孩。她从没做错过什么，不是吗？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof16
: It’s not about what {i}she{/i} did wrong...it’s about the her {i}inside{/i} of {i}her.
lines.zh: : 跟{i}她{/i}做错了什么无关……跟她{i}里面{/i}的那个{i}她{/i}有关。

lines.en: : But I thought you just said {i}she{/i} was inside of her to begin with because-
lines.zh: : 可你刚才不是说，{i}她{/i}一开始就在她里面，因为——

lines.en: : You’ve seen the tattoo, right? That big spider on her chest?
lines.zh: : 你见过那个纹身吧？她胸口那只大蜘蛛？

lines.en: : Yes, but-
lines.zh: : 见过，可是——

lines.en: : See, I’ve had some time to play with this body while you were off diddling your students. And, you wanna know something crazy? That tattoo’s covering something up. Something {i}awesome.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你看，你跑去玩你的学生那会儿，我有的是时间摆弄这具身体。你想知道一件很疯狂的事吗？那个纹身盖住了什么东西。一件{i}超棒{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : Wanna take a guess at what it is?
lines.zh: : 要不要猜猜是什么？

lines.en: : You-

lines.zh: : 时间到！是一道疤，混蛋！

lines.en: : Your first love lives on! It just has a different house now!
lines.zh: : 你的初恋还活着！只是换了个房子住！

lines.en: : How cool and dramatic and awesome is that?! It’s like a scene out of one of those soap operas you people watch, just {i}real!{/i}
lines.zh: : 这有多酷、多戏剧、多带劲？！就像你们人类看的那些肥皂剧里的场景，只不过是{i}真人真事{/i}！

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof18
: And {i}that’s{/i} why we can get in here. Not because of “Kaori.” Because of {i}Sekai.{/i} And how {i}that{/i} dime-piece actually {i}got it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以这{i}就是{/i}我们能进来的原因。不是因为「Kaori」。是因为 {i}Sekai{/i}。还有{i}那个{/i}极品尤物到底是怎么{i}弄到它{/i}的。

lines.en: : You remember what she was like near the end of her life, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你还记得她临终前是什么样子吗，Akira？

lines.en: : Bullshit. Yes, you do. She was {i}losing{/i} it. She was {i}tainted.{/i} But her infection made her even more beautiful than she already was.
lines.zh: : 放屁。你记得。她在一点点{i}垮掉{/i}。她被{i}污染{/i}了。可那份感染让她比原本还要美。

lines.en: : So many voices, all fighting for control over a {i}prospect!{/i} Like scouts at a college baseball game! And she could hear {i}all{/i} of them! She was being pulled in so many directions!
lines.zh: : 那么多声音，全都在争夺对一个{i}好苗子{/i}的控制权！就像大学棒球比赛现场的星探！而且她{i}全都{/i}能听见！她被拉向那么多不同的方向！

lines.en: : It’s the same thing happening to you now! We all {i}want{/i} you because you’re different! Because you give us something we lack! And we can not {i}exist{/i} without people {i}like{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 现在同样的事正发生在你身上！我们都{i}想要{/i}你，因为你不一样！因为你能给我们缺少的东西！没有{i}像{/i}你这样的人，我们就无法{i}存在{/i}！

lines.en: : In order for a god to live, that god must have people who believe in them. And with your help, I could have been {i}everywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : 一个神要活下去，就必须有信奉它的人。而有了你的帮助，我本可以{i}无处不在{/i}。

lines.en: : Like that fucker Jesus and his whole “I am also my father” BS or whatever shit he tricked people into believing. I don’t know. Fuck that guy.
lines.zh: : 就像那个叫耶稣的混蛋和他那套「我也是我父」的鬼话，或者他骗人去相信的那些破玩意儿。我也不知道。去他的。

lines.en: : There’s no way.........
: Which part are you most confused about? That your red-headed sex-mom is still kicking? The fact that you’re talking to God? Or is this costume just that cute?
lines.zh: : 你最搞不懂的是哪部分？你那个红头发的「性爱妈妈」还活着？你在跟神说话这件事？还是说我这身装扮就是那么可爱？
: 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t even know what......
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道什么……

lines.en: : I have so many questions, but......
lines.zh: : 我有好多问题，可是……

lines.en: : All of them are just......
lines.zh: : 它们全都只是……

lines.en: : It’s natural to have questions. And it’s natural to ask them in a place like this — with all the memories you’ve made here and how special you may {i}think{/i} it is.
lines.zh: : 有问题是自然的。在这种地方问出来也很自然——毕竟你在这儿留下了那么多回忆，你{i}觉得{/i}它有多特别。

lines.en: : But {i}that’s{/i} wrong too. And your little “Apocalypse Squad” is about to find that out.
lines.zh: : 但{i}那{/i}也是错的。而你的那个小小的「末日小队」马上就会发现这一点。

lines.en: : You know what comes next. And this time you’re all alone. So what do you think is going to happen? Who do you think is going to “carry over?” Just you? All three or...four of you?
lines.zh: : 你知道接下来会发生什么。而这一次你孤身一人。那你觉得会发生什么？你觉得谁会「被带过去」？只有你？你们三个，还是……四个？

lines.en: : How many even are there now? And when the Heaven’s Web is everybody else going to catch on?
lines.zh: : 现在到底有几个了？等天网铺开的时候，其他人又要到什么时候才会察觉？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof19
: Come to think of it...
lines.zh: : 说起来……

lines.en: : One of them {i}did{/i} catch on.
lines.zh: : 其中一个{i}已经{/i}察觉了。

lines.en: : Nodoka. And she was here...{i}just{/i} before you were.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。她在你之前……来过这里。

lines.en: : I doubt that’ll be happening again, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我怀疑不会再有第二次了。

lines.en: : She’s been a real thorn in our side ever since she found her mom’s books. Those “intellectual” types aren’t meant for this line of thinking. And she flew a little close to the sun...
lines.zh: : 自从她找到她妈妈的书以后，就成了我们的一根刺。那种「知识分子」类型本来就不该碰这种思路。而她飞得离太阳太近了点……

lines.en: : So I melted her wings.
lines.zh: : 所以我把她的翅膀融了。

lines.en: : Sorry, not sorry. Do humans still say that?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但不抱歉。人类现在还这么说吗？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof20
: Ugh. Please don’t tell me we’re going to be entering another one of your “silent arcs.” I just had to sit through one of the longest ones yet.
lines.zh: : 呃。别告诉我们要进入你的又一个「沉默篇章」了。我刚熬过有史以来最长的一个。

lines.en: : How much...of this...does Kaori know?...
lines.zh: : 这些事……Kaori 知道多少？……

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof21
: A good amount, probably. But I doubt she can make much sense of any of it. Like, imagine you had more than just me inside your head. That shit would weigh on you.
lines.zh: : 大概不少吧。但我怀疑她也理不出什么头绪。就好比想象一下，你脑子里除了我之外还有别的房客。那种破事会压死你的。

lines.en: : There’s only so much the human mind can comprehend at once. And when you have the thoughts of a bunch of different “all knowing” beings swimming around in there, some shit’s gonna get tangled up.
lines.zh: : 人脑一次能理解的东西就那么多。当有一堆不同的「全知」存在的念头在里面游来游去，总会有些东西缠成一团。

lines.en: : I just...don’t...
lines.zh: : 我只是……不……

lines.en: : Why didn’t any of them do what you’re doing now?...
lines.zh: : 为什么它们没有一个像你现在这样做过？……

lines.en: : You mean talking to you {i}through{/i} the Airbnb instead of just wiggling inside of {i}your{/i} head and doing it there? Because it’s against the rules.
lines.zh: : 你是说，{i}通过{/i}民宿跟你说话，而不是在{i}你{/i}脑子里蠕动、在那儿说？因为那违反规则。

lines.en: : Whose rules?...
lines.zh: : 谁的规则？……

lines.en: : You’re gods, aren’t you?...
lines.zh: : 你们不是神吗？……

lines.en: : Yes, but not all of us were born that way.
lines.zh: : 是，但我们不全是天生就是神。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof22
: There are many ways in which one can become a god, but the part that {i}really{/i} matters is being able to provide something for someone.
lines.zh: : 成神的方式有很多，但{i}最关键{/i}的，是能为某个人提供点什么。

lines.en: : Look at cats and dogs and other domesticated animals. To them, humans are akin to God. They provide food, shelter, the whole shabang. And that’s what {i}we{/i} do for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 看看猫啊狗啊这些被驯养的动物。对它们来说，人类就等同于神。人类提供食物、住所，全套的。而这就是{i}我们{/i}为{i}你{/i}做的事。

lines.en: : Well...maybe not food and shelter. You guys have gotten pretty good at figuring that part out. But we give you something to believe in. And with how curious your species is, that probably means...something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许除了食物和住所。你们在这方面已经挺拿手了。但我们给了你们可以信仰的东西。以你们这个物种的好奇心，那大概意味着……什么吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know, man. There’s a reason we’re dying out, though. And it’s because you guys keep asking questions about how it’s even {i}possible{/i} for us to be alive when all logic states we shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，伙计。不过我们正在消亡，是有原因的。就是因为你们总在问：所有逻辑都说我们不该存在，那我们{i}到底是怎么{/i}活着的。

lines.en: : That shit’s annoying as hell though because most of us are {i}created{/i} by you guys. So, like...why even bother making a god at all when you’re just going to abandon it?
lines.zh: : 可那破事烦得要死，因为我们大多是被你们{i}造出来{/i}的。所以……既然造出来就打算抛弃，那当初何必造一个神呢？

lines.en: : We can’t ever {i}die{/i} until we’re truly forgotten, so most of us just have to fucking pace back and forth forever and ever, twiddling our thumbs while waiting for that to happen.
lines.zh: : 在真正被遗忘之前，我们永远{i}死不了{/i}，所以我们大多数人只能他妈的来来回回踱步，永生永世地转着大拇指等那一天到来。

lines.en: : Others take the opposite path, though. Others want to become stronger. So they reach out and touch you any way they can. Sometimes literally, sometimes not.
lines.zh: : 不过也有人走相反的路。有人想变得更强。所以它们伸出手，用尽一切方式去触碰你。有时候是字面意义上的，有时候不是。

lines.en: : The ones who reach the top of the ladder are the ones who make the rules. And the punishment we receive for breaking them is even worse a fate than death.
lines.zh: : 爬到梯子顶端的那批，才制定规则。而我们违反规则所受的惩罚，是比死亡更惨的下场。

lines.en: : They turn us into {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它们把我们变成{i}你们{/i}。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof23
: Humans...animals...plants...{i}anything{/i} could have been a god at some point. And anything can turn back {i}into{/i} a god once someone believes it.
lines.zh: : 人类……动物……植物……{i}任何东西{/i}在某个时刻都可能是神。而只要有人相信，任何东西都能重新{i}变回{/i}神。

lines.en: : It doesn’t need to be a group of people who believe it either. And it doesn’t need to be approved. It just needs to be thought — because we {i}do{/i} defy logic. But that makes all of us equal.
lines.zh: : 也不需要一群人相信。也不需要被批准。只需要被想到——因为我们{i}本来就{/i}不合逻辑。可这让我们全都平等。

lines.en: : No one of us can be more {i}real{/i} than the others because it’s all just make believe. And, to some people, that makes all of this seem silly. Which is where those promises come in.
lines.zh: : 我们之中没有谁比别人更{i}真实{/i}，因为这一切归根结底都是编出来的。而对某些人来说，这让整件事显得很傻。承诺就是这么来的。

lines.en: : But even {i}those{/i} are only as real as you make them out to be.
lines.zh: : 可就连{i}那些{/i}承诺，也只在你能把它当成真的时才是真的。

lines.en: : Which turns the whole spirituality thing into a game of choosing which benefits sound the coolest or whatever it is that will help you cope with the fact that you {i}will{/i} die one day. You’re mortal.
lines.zh: : 于是整个「灵性」这件事，就变成了一场游戏——挑听起来最酷的好处，或者挑那个能帮你接受「你总有一天{i}会{/i}死」这件事的东西。你是凡人。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof24
: But what happens if you start to think of {i}yourself{/i} as God? Can you make yourself immortal by just willing it into existence?
lines.zh: : 可如果你开始把{i}自己{/i}当成神呢？你能不能就靠一个念头让自己不朽？

lines.en: : Do you think that’s what {i}you’ve{/i} done? Do you think that explains where you’ve found yourself and why you can’t escape? Is it you? Or someone else? Who is it? Why? What do they see in you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}你{/i}就是这么干的吗？你觉得这能解释你为什么沦落至此、为什么逃不出去吗？是你自己吗？还是别人？他们到底看上你什么了？

lines.en: : There’s a place at the bottom of the Wishing Well where forgotten gods can rest. That’s where I was until you came along and pulled me up. But how did you find me there? And who forgot me in the first place?
lines.zh: : 许愿井底下有个地方，被遗忘的神可以在那里安息。在你出现、把我拉上来之前，我就在那儿。可你是怎么在那儿找到我的？当初又是谁忘了我？

lines.en: : I could tell you I know the answer, sure. But I’d be lying. Just like I’ve lied about so many other things. Just like I’m {i}still{/i} lying, but that’s just what we do.
lines.zh: : 我当然可以告诉你我知道答案。但那是撒谎。就像我在那么多别的事情上撒过谎。就像我现在{i}还在{/i}撒谎——可我们就是干这个的。

lines.en: : It isn’t just humans who are searching for life and death while attempting to make sense of everything in between. It’s {i}everyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不只是人类在寻找生与死、试图弄懂中间的一切。是{i}所有人{/i}都一样。

lines.en: : You are our gods. We are yours. These are the gears that power the machine — this is the bucket that pulls water from the well.
lines.zh: : 你们是我们的神。我们是你们的神。这就是驱动机器的齿轮——这就是从井里打水的那只桶。

lines.en: : But one day, that well will dry up.
lines.zh: : 但总有一天，那口井会干涸。

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof25
when every god has been forgotten-
lines.zh: 当每一个神都被遗忘——

lines.en: when humanity has found the cure for the poison they’ve concocted-
lines.zh: 当人类找到了他们自己调制的毒药的解药——

lines.en: that is when time will move again.
lines.zh: 那就是时间重新流动之时。

lines.en: that is when we will both be free.
lines.zh: 那就是我们两个都获得自由之时。

lines.en: this will be the last talk we ever have.
lines.zh: 这会是我们最后一次交谈。

lines.en: i have sacrificed myself to someone for something and even i can’t tell you what it is anymore. i just know that it’s there. and it is vengeful.
lines.zh: 我为了某样东西、把自己献祭给了某个人，如今连我自己都说不清那是什么了。我只知道它在那儿。而且它心怀怨恨。

lines.en: i have always been the weakest god because only you have known that i exist.
lines.zh: 我一直是最弱的那个神，因为只有你知道我存在。

lines.en: and now that you know that i don’t, i’ll be just another thought.
lines.zh: 而既然现在你知道我并不存在，我就只会成为又一个念头。

lines.en: maybe you’ll see me again as a blade of grass or a cat and think to yourself about what could have been if you were not such a bitch. and then maybe i will {i}be{/i} again.
lines.zh: 也许有一天你会以一根草、或一只猫的样子再见到我，然后心想：如果你不是这么个贱人的话，本来会怎样。到那时，也许我又会{i}存在{/i}了。

lines.en: but for now, i can not. and all i ask is that you wait to remember me. i ask that you wait until you’re lonely and create me once more. only then, can we find perfect harmony.
lines.zh: 但现在不行。我只求你先别急着记起我。我求你等到孤独的时候，再把我创造一次。只有到那时，我们才能找到完美的和谐。

lines.en: : So...you’re just...going to leave? Right now? But you were so opposed to it every time I tried before.
lines.zh: : 所以……你就要……走了？就现在？可我以前每次想这么做，你都百般反对。

lines.en: i didn’t want to leave you alone.
lines.zh: 我不想丢下你一个人。

lines.en: i was far too concerned.
lines.zh: 我太担心了。

lines.en: : Concerned about what?! You’ve done nothing but torment me the whole time you’ve been here! Don’t go seeking some spontaneous emotional send off now!
lines.zh: : 担心什么？！你在这儿从头到尾除了折磨我什么都没干过！别现在才来找什么临别的煽情！

lines.en: i was exactly what you wanted me to be — a scapegoat.
lines.zh: 我正是你希望我成为的那个样子——一个替罪羊。

lines.en: i was something to hate to give you a break from hating yourself.
lines.zh: 我是一个供你憎恨的东西，好让你从憎恨自己中喘口气。

lines.en: but that’s all i’ve ever been able to offer. and it isn’t enough anymore.
lines.zh: 但这就是我唯一能给的了。而现在，这已经不够了。

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他妈的——

lines.en: everything you can imagine is real, akira.
lines.zh: 你能想象的一切都是真的，akira。

lines.en: i was always the one you could trust.
lines.zh: 我一直都是那个你可以信任的人。

lines.en: but just because i am falling down the well once more does not mean that i have not taken it upon myself to try and make things easier for you in the coming days.
lines.zh: 但即便我再一次坠入井底，也不代表我没有主动为你接下来那些日子做点安排，好让你好过一些。

lines.en: you will soon receive a gift. multiple gifts. things i have hidden not where but {i}when.{/i} and one of them is sure to move you.
lines.zh: 你很快就会收到一份礼物。好几份礼物。是我藏起来的东西——藏的不是地方，是{i}时间{/i}。其中一件一定会让你动容。

lines.en: but there is fallacy. i have lied so many times. and there is no reason for you to believe me now.
lines.zh: 但这里也有谬误。我撒过太多次谎。而你现在没有任何理由相信我。

lines.en: : Yeah! And I fucking don’t! Because all this {i}really{/i} does is leave me with a million more questions! Is {i}that{/i} your parting gift?! Making everything harder?!
lines.zh: : 是啊！我他妈当然不信！因为这一切只是给我留下了一百万个新问题！{i}这{/i}就是你的临别赠礼吗？！把一切都搞得更难？！

lines.en: kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: 差不多吧，对。

lines.en: you’ve gotta admit, though. life’s more entertaining that way, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 不过你得承认，人生这样才更有意思，不是吗？

lines.en: : Fuck off. And tell all of your “friends” to leave Kaori alone. If any of {i}that{/i} was even true as this isn’t all just another hallucination. Which, hey — knowing me, it probably is.
lines.zh: : 滚吧。还有，叫你那些「朋友们」离 Kaori 远点。如果{i}这一切{/i}哪怕有一句是真的——而不是又一次幻觉。话说，按我对自己的了解，大概就是幻觉。

lines.en: that’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: knowing you, it probably is.
lines.zh: 按你对自己的了解，大概就是。

lines.en: and if you keep that mindset, that’s probably all it ever will be.
lines.zh: 而如果你一直抱着这种想法，那它大概永远都只是幻觉。

lines.en: but there are others who want you. there are other lies that need to be told.
lines.zh: 但还有别的存在想要你。还有别的谎言需要被说出。

lines.en: and you will never find peace if you keep letting them in.
lines.zh: 而如果你一直放它们进来，就永远找不到安宁。

lines.en: : Is there anything else? Or can I have my mind back now?
lines.zh: : 还有别的事吗？还是说我可以把我的脑子拿回来了？

lines.en: scene kaoriontheroof26
{b}IT WAS NEVER YOURS TO BEGIN WITH, YOU UNGRATEFUL PIG! I’LL CUT OFF YOUR COCK AND GRIND IT INTO BEEF FOR MENCHI-KATSU!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}那玩意儿从来就不是你的，你这忘恩负义的猪！我要把你的鸡巴剁下来，绞成牛肉做炸肉饼！{/b}

lines.en: : Yeah, {i}there’s{/i} the Pareidolia I know.
lines.zh: : 对，这{i}才是{/i}我认识的那个 pareidolia。

lines.en: {b}SUCH A BEING DOES NOT EXIST. YOU SPEAK NOW TO THE MOUTH OF SELF-SACRIFICE! MAY YOUR LEGS GET CAUGHT BETWEEN MY TEETH. MAY YOUR ARMS-{/b}
lines.zh: {b}此等存在并不存在。你此刻交谈的对象，是自我牺牲之口！愿你的双腿卡在我的牙缝里。愿你的双臂——{/b}
